name: Cuisine minceur
summary: Michel Guérard's light cooking for a spa hotel. Each dish has few calories but the plate of a three-star kitchen: steam instead of butter, fromage blanc and vegetable purée instead of cream and flour, and a small portion.

philosophy.core_thesis: A dish can be low in fat and sugar and still be haute cuisine, if the cook uses exact technique and fresh produce in place of butter and cream.
design_principles: Cook in steam, in a court-bouillon or in a covered pan with a spoon of water, not in butter.
Bind a sauce with fromage blanc, yoghurt, a vegetable purée or a reduced stock; leave out flour, cream and egg yolk.
Count the energy of each dish and keep a full menu at about 500 to 800 kcal.
Season with herbs, lemon, vinegar and spices so that the salt and the fat can stay low.
Use no sugar in a sauce; take the sweet taste from fruit and vegetables.
Serve each dish as a small portion on a large white plate, so the meal still has many courses.
Plate with the care of a three-star kitchen: a sauce pooled under the food, one herb on top.
Keep the taste of each ingredient clear; do not hide it behind a diet label.
anti_patterns: A sauce thickened with flour or egg yolk
Butter or cream as the base of a sauce
A dessert of cream and sugar
A bare plate of boiled food with no seasoning
A menu that names the calories on the plate

plating.composition: A small portion of steamed fish or meat at the centre of a wide plate with a pool of pale sauce and two or three vegetables around it.
plating.plate: A white round porcelain plate of 280 to 300 mm with a thin rim.
plating.portion: A main piece of 80 to 120 g with 30 ml of sauce and 60 to 100 g of vegetables; the whole main dish is about 200 kcal.
plating.height: The food stands 15 to 30 mm high; the sauce is a thin pool of 2 mm under the main piece.
rules: Pool the sauce first, then set the steamed piece on it.
Cut the vegetables into thin strips, balls or discs of one size, and cook them to al dente.
Leave about 45 per cent of the plate empty.
Add one herb or a few chive stems as the only garnish.
Serve the dessert as a small portion of fruit with a sorbet or a fromage blanc cream.

pantry.rule: Choose lean fish, shellfish, poultry and vegetables; use fromage blanc and herbs as the main sauce makers, and add a little oil or butter only where the dish cannot do without it.

technique.bases: A clear vegetable stock, a fish fumet, a purée of cooked vegetables and a bowl of fromage blanc that the cook whisks with lemon and herbs.
technique.details: A fish steamed on a bed of herbs, a vegetable purée that binds a sauce, a sauce whisked cold with fromage blanc, a spoon of reduced stock in place of a pat of butter.

flavour.profile: Clean, green and acid: lemon, herbs, light fish broth and the sweet taste of fresh vegetables and fruit.
flavour.balance: Acid and herb lead; salt stays low, umami comes from reduced stock and shellfish, and sweet comes from fruit and carrot.
flavour.fat: Fat gives about 10 to 20 per cent of the energy of a main dish; the cook adds a few drops of oil for flavour.
flavour.seasoning: Fresh herbs, lemon juice, vinegar and ground pepper go in at the end; the cook uses very little salt and no sugar in sauces.

palette.strategy: Use a white plate with the green of herbs and vegetables, the pale pink of fish and a very pale sauce.

service.format: A fixed menu for a spa guest: the waiter serves each small plate from the kitchen, with a gap of a few minutes between courses.
service.courses: Five or six small courses at a dinner, with a total of about 650 kcal for the whole menu.
service.tableware: Large white plates, small crystal glasses for a little wine and a pot of herbal tea; white linen.
service.setting: A spa hotel in a park in the Landes with a chef-owner, a medium brigade and a dining room for the guests of the thermal baths.

dishes.dish: Salad of lobster and green vegetables
Steamed sole with a fromage blanc and herb sauce
Steamed chicken breast with a vegetable purée
Spring vegetables cooked in a covered pan
Fresh berries with a light fromage blanc cream

positive: steamed fish on a wide white plate

emotion.target_response: The calm of a meal that is both a pleasure and a cure: clear, bright and light on the body.

use_cases: a menu for a spa or wellness hotel
a food photograph of a light plate with a pale sauce
a diet menu that still looks like fine dining
avoid_when: the brief wants rich sauces or a large portion
the brief wants a rustic or home table
the brief wants spice or heat

modifiers.how: Allow a beurre blanc and a spoon of cream, and raise the fat share to 30 per cent.
Drop the calorie rules; keep the steamed and raw vegetables and name the farm.

sources.title: Michel Guérard, La Grande Cuisine minceur (1976)
